name: Bhai Ne Bola Karne Ka Matlab Karne Ka
visual_description: Circuit (Arshad Warsi) from Munna Bhai M.B.B.S. giving an intense, unquestioning stare while enforcing Munna's instructions to others.
usage_context: Used to convey blind loyalty, unquestioning obedience to a boss or best friend's absurd demands, or following instructions without asking questions.

example.top_text: When your best friend says 'chal usko block kar de'

text_areas.description: Scenario prompting unquestioned obedience or action
